_about: Every qscommons project, in the order the site lists them. Each project gets its own screen on /projects/ (heading, summary, facts, links and its example as a code window), its link groups in the nav's Projects menu (the first two groups across all projects) and its source link in the footer. `featured` marks the project the nav's release card and the Projects page's opening lead with. Example lines are plain text; they are escaped when built. `version` is the one place a project's current version is written: the status line, the nav's release card and its title, the Projects page pill and every {{version:<id>}} token in a page follow it. Release `note` and `lines` describe that release, so update them with it.
